negative_scope_items.rationale: Only plan_init and plan_retirement are accepted writable operations in M4.
LLM remains sole semantic decision maker; Core is executor-neutral; UCP is mechanical.
Direct Core and Unified Ingress remain valid first-class entry surfaces.
CLI is a machine adapter for declared Forge operations only.
Git inspection is read-only within project boundary; generic Git write is forbidden.
GitHub adapter is typed transport behind PlanAuthorityMutationPort only.
Subject graph CAS and external authority are non-atomic independent systems.
Durable journal store is an abstract port; file-backed adapter is reference/test-only.
Retries require fresh authorization and newly issued CapabilityLease.
Ambiguity in Subject, successor, or role binding returns NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE.
Automatic compensating mutations or rollbacks of decisions are forbidden.
Testing uses fake adapter and test stores; production Issue #9 mutation is forbidden.
M4-R is a separate milestone slice for final regression and fixture modernization.
